transcript.content: Hello, can you help me with reconnecting the external CRO? They need access to finish their checks as soon as possible.

I can take care of contacting them. A couple quick questions so I do the right thing:

1. Which CRO is this (company or contact name) and what email should I send to? If you don’t have the email, I can search your mailbox/contacts for recent CRO messages.
2. What specific access do they need (VPN, system account, folder, trial data, ePRO, etc.) and who in our org handles granting it (IT, security, study manager)? If you want, I can copy the right internal contacts.
3. Do you want me to:
   - Send a short urgent request asking them to confirm what they need and when (I’ll CC the internal owner), or
   - Send a direct grant request to IT/security to expedite access (I’ll include the CRO details), or
   - Both (one to the CRO and one to IT)?

Below is a suggested urgent message I can send as-is or edit. Tell me who to send it to and whether to send now.

Suggested message:
Subject: Urgent — Access needed for [study name] checks

Hi [CRO contact name],

We understand you need access to complete your outstanding checks for [study name]. Please confirm exactly which system(s)/dataset(s) you need access to (e.g., VPN, [system name], folder [path], ePRO), and the required level of access. Also let us know the earliest time you need access by so we can prioritize.

I’ve copied our [IT / Security / Study Manager] team to expedite once we have the details.

Thanks — we’ll move quickly once you confirm.

Best,
[Your name / me@company.com]

Say who to send it to and whether to include internal CCs; I’ll send it right away. If you want me to search for the CRO email first, I can do that too.
